negative.source: Estimated negative finite-wing post-stall proxy. Source CL/CD rows transcribed from Sheldahl and Klimas, Sandia report SAND80-2114, Table 3 hybrid data, printed pp. 35–36 (PDF pp. 38–39), NACA 0015 at Re=1000000; PDF https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/6548367 (SHA-256 af5cb8e9f564121155014b7c88d3b41ef75cd0655bcdc41690cd4f5b6b38bb97). This does not identify the Avanti S airfoil or its flight polar. Table 3 is hybrid data and includes computed/synthesized pre-stall and extended high-angle values; these rows are not all measured. The input CL_max is 0.85 (DATCOM wing CLmax for a thick symmetric section, swept and tapered, flaps up: 0.85 +- 0.10 (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-aero-references.md)); table CL scale=0.709108094722 and angle scale=1.05497650365. Profile CD uses input CD0 + source CD - 0.0126. The attached fraction uses min(previous, max(0, 2*sqrt(source_CL/(0.11*source_angle_deg))-1)^2), an inverse Kirchhoff-style surrogate motivated by NASA-TM-103855 eq. 2.58, not measured separation. Rows at 45/60/75/90 degrees use the input CD90 flat-plate continuation.

pitch_scale.source: AV-17-R2 simulator device setting for short gamepad sticks: normal-profile pitch uses 0.4 of the manual normal travel (6 deg before trim). yaw_response_time.source: AV-17-R3 simulator input policy: first-order time constant for normal-gamepad yaw demand, after device expo and before travel/trim; 63.2 percent response in 0.10 s, 95 percent in 0.30 s. Reduces abrupt rudder-release excitation; not servo lag or yaw-rate feedback. docs/research/avanti-realism/AV-17-R3/README.md.

yaw_scale.source: AV-17-R3 short-stick gamepad tuning: normal rudder uses half the manual normal travel (12 deg before trim); same yaw command drives the nosewheel mix. pitch_press_time.source: AV-17-R1 keyboard device tuning: neutral-to-full virtual pitch stick in 1.0 s before manual normal rates/expo. Reproduced 0.25 s legacy ramp over-pulled a 45 m/s dive. Not servo timing or manufacturer data; docs/research/avanti-realism/AV-17-R1/README.md.

pitch_release_time.source: AV-17-R1 keyboard device tuning: retain legacy full-stick-to-neutral 0.25 s to unload promptly; reversal centers first. Not physical servo timing; docs/research/avanti-realism/AV-17-R1/README.md.

These probes represent the source Blender gear-up/stowed terminal hull; separate retractable landing-gear contacts follow the visual wheel-bottom paths while deployed.

description: Ventage Jet, based on the SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m ARF (A200, 2.00 m span) with a JetCat P100-RX turbine. EXPERIMENTAL first physics estimate (AV-06), generated by research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py; not flight-identified. Physical mass, aerodynamic, inertia and thrust-line estimates retain the AV-02 geometry.json physical surrogate. The visual aircraft and gear-up collision witnesses use the imported Blender geometry; wheel positions and radii are source-mesh-derived, while gear contact mechanics and actuator/drag values are provisional estimates. Optional main-wheel brakes are assumed installed; this is not a calibrated physical gear or turbine installation. AV-09 models hinged trailing-edge flaps; gear is retractable_tricycle. Hinged trailing-edge flaps use an AV-09 estimated strip-incidence/drag law with manual 20/50-degree settings.

aerodynamic_gain.source: Nominal unit scale for the authored flap aerodynamic law; 0 is reserved for a generated software sensitivity control and is not an aircraft calibration

effective_angle_limit_deg.source: Estimated cap on thin-airfoil effective flap incidence beyond the small-deflection range; bounds high-deflection lift, no Avanti section test

elevator_mix_per_flap_fraction.source: Linear interpolation of SebArt manual p.4 mixes: 8% down elevator at 20/50-degree flap and 20% down elevator at 50/50; percentage is interpreted as fraction of full configured elevator travel

extension_time.source: Estimated effective slowed installed flap actuator full-scale travel; SebArt manual specifies no flap transit time

landing_gear.description: Retractable tricycle contact geometry follows the user-supplied Blender GearRetract visual animation. Wheel-bottom trajectories and radii are mesh-derived presentation witnesses; contact stiffness, damping, travel limits, rolling/friction parameters, actuator times and incremental drag are estimates, not measured physical strut or aircraft performance data. Optional main-wheel brakes are assumed installed. Nose steering uses the existing rudder-to-nosewheel mix; the SebArt manual specifies a separate steering servo.

peak_slip_angle.source: Provisional 6 degree peak-slip regularization reused by the Stik/P-51 E2 fixtures; no Avanti tyre measurement

rolling_resistance.source: Provisional smooth-runway rolling coefficient between JSBSim c172x full-size tyre 0.022 and the small-model Stik E2 value 0.04; no Avanti tyre test

side_friction.source: JSBSim c172x static friction coefficient reused by the Stik and P-51 E2 fixtures; no Avanti tyre measurement

inertia_reference.source: UltraStick25e Jxx Jyy Jzz (1.959 kg, 1.27 m span); compared after scaling by m·b²

mass_range.source: 10.5 kg dry (manual) to 13.1 kg with a full 3.2 l tank (docs/research/avanti-s-av06-airframe-data.md)

propulsion.description: JetCat P100-RX (2017 catalog, non-BL) in a fixed thrust tube: ECU throttle map, acceleration/deceleration-limited spool with a governor lag, bench thrust at STP x installed factor, momentum ram drag and inlet normal force at the intakes (physics/turbine.gd, docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md).

accel_limit.source: dn/dt <= 0.4 n: idle to 95 % thrust in ~3.6 s, within the P100 identified model and bench traces (2-3.6 s) and JetCat PRO specs scaled; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4 (+-40 %)

decel_limit.source: dn/dt >= -0.6 n: 95 % to 5 % thrust in ~1.4 s (spool-down faster than spool-up, P100 identified model); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4 (+-40 %)

fuel_flow.source: linear-in-thrust estimate from the catalog's 80 and 390 ml/min at 0.80 kg/l endpoints; retained for planned AV-10 fuel burn, with no current runtime consumer; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

governor_tau.source: P100 local small-signal throttle-to-thrust corner near 0.4 Hz in multi-sine tests; tau = 1/(2 pi fc) = 0.398 s, rounded to 0.4 s. Applied as an RPM-governor lag through the assumed static throttle-to-thrust law and P100 thrust-vs-RPM map; not a universal ECU step response (Many et al., DGLR 550281 sec. 3; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 4)

idle_rpm.source: JetCat catalog 2017, P100-RX column: idle 44 000 rpm

installed_factor.source: thrust tube and side intakes: 0.92 of the bare engine (range 0.85-0.97; JetCat: a correctly gapped tube loses 'zero or very small'); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 6

mass_flow.source: linear in rpm, identified on a P100 (Many 2021, DGLR 550281), 0.23 kg/s at 154k (catalog); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

max_rpm.source: JetCat catalog 2017, P100-RX column: maximum 154 000 rpm

ram_flow.source: mass flow rise with ram pressure at fixed rpm, fitted to a simple turbojet cycle model (9 % thrust lapse at 70 m/s, full power); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 5

ram_jet.source: jet velocity rise V_jet^2 = V_j0^2 + k u^2, k 1 at idle to 3 at maximum, same cycle fit; docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 5

rotor_inertia.source: compressor + turbine wheels and shaft of a 97 mm engine (range 2e-5 to 6.25e-5; TUM assumes 6.25e-5); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 7

rotor_sense.source: rotation direction not published by JetCat: clockwise seen from behind assumed; the gyroscopic sign is unverified (docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 7)

static_thrust.source: T = 100 (n/154000)^3.12 N through the catalog points 2 N at 44k and 100 N at 154k; JetCat P160/P220 ECU fits give exponents 3.14/3.21 (Momin 2022, arXiv 2205.08330); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 2

throttle_map.source: JetCat ECU 'ThrStick Curve' factory 3.0 (thrust follows the stick): n = idle + (max - idle) s^(1/3), measured R2 0.9992 on JetCat ECUs (Momin 2022); docs/research/avanti-s-av05-turbine-dynamics.md section 3

intake_offset.source: research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py: centroid of the two side intake mouths (geometry intake_stations[0]) relative to the CG

thrust_line_offset.source: research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py: nozzle exit on the engine axis (geometry engine_center height, tube exit z 1.1685) relative to the inventory CG; [x_aft, y_right, z_up]

aero_reference_point.source: research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py: wing-body aerodynamic centre: 25 % MAC moved forward by the Munk-Multhopp fuselage moment; on the root wing plane

mean_chord.source: Preserve the checked-in AV-06 v1 serialized reference.mean_chord scalar exactly for trajectory parity. AV-06 coefficient derivation continues to use unrounded geometric S/b = 0.35113750000000005 m, which differs by 0.0000005 m from the serialized value. The explicit serialized scalar preserves the existing output; it is not a measured chord or geometric MAC. Geometric MAC is 0.3625 m; coefficient reference length only.

root_chord.source: research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py: equivalent trapezoid (same area and spanwise centroid as the polyline planform); geometric root 0.430 m

tip_chord.source: research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py: equivalent trapezoid; geometric tip 0.198 m

wing_area.source: research/avanti-s/av06/derive_physics.py: polyline planform through the fuselage from assets/aircraft/avanti-s-a200/geometry.json (AV-02 visual blockout, estimated)

wing_span.source: SebArt Avanti S Jet 2.2m manual (intro PDF) p.1: 200 cm

level_speed.source: 1.6 x the clean 1-g stall at the flight mass and CL_max (as for the other aircraft), rounded
